summary.headline: Climacteric Periods and Diseases
summary.text: Astrological prognosis calculates climacteric periods from the walks and aspects of Mars, Venus, the Sun, and Moon, identifying illnesses, bodily afflictions, religious loss, and the lord of the inquiry’s death. The passages specify years and months, including Saturn squares, solar trines, lunar diameters, planetary bodies, zodiacal squares, Libra, the midheaven, and planetary terms.
